fomod.Name: OStim Together
fomod.Author: OStim Together project
fomod.Description: Synchronizes OStim Standalone scenes through Skyrim Together Reborn. Uses one unified remote scene-anchor pipeline for physical furniture, free-standing and wall scenes, with synchronized participant alignment, scene controls and NPC undressing. v0.35.6 keeps the validated scene/transport/PPA behavior and makes OCum CumOverlays use one common RaceMenu repair path in every scene type: free/wall scenes no longer run the additional FreeSceneOverlayReplay fallback after the native RevertOverlay relink. Both free and physical-furniture scenes now rely on OCumStateSync plus RaceMenu RevertOverlay(resetDiffuse=false) and the same deferred material reapply passes, matching the 0.35.5 furniture test that rendered the 3D overlay on both clients.
